SUNITA PAWAR

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Java Backend Developer with 10 Years of Experience, Agile, Java[8,11,17], Hibernate, JPA, Microservices, Spring Boot, Kafka(Basic), MySQL, Docker(Basic), Liquibase, OpenAPI, Kubernetes(Basic), GitKraken, Postman, and ArgoCD .

CONTACT

Address: Mumbai India

Phone: 9767374696.

Email: sunitapawar046@gmail.com

ACCOMPLISHMENTS

03/29/2014, Academic - participated in 3rd International Conference on Recent Trends in Engineering & Technology (ICRTET 2014) and Published paper on Automated Suspicious Object Detection System Using Tele-Eye project.

2/28/2026, Deloitte - Rewarded with spot and Applause award for superior

work in the project.

2/12/2022, Nice - Participated in the Innovation day held in nice. No news loss from Ravenpack; the company later implemented this idea in the next release.

4/2025, Genpact - Generative AI with Microsoft 365 Copilot Certificate

5/2025, Genpact - Github copilot Ceritificate

WORK HISTORY

Senior Principal Consultant, 08/2024 to Current

Genpact - Mumbai, India Client : Morgan Stanley

Worked in Investment Managment sector.

Mainly worked on Store Procedure, Trigger, Table Modifications.

UI changes from Project specific Portal only.

Understanding the tickets, estimations, code changes, deployment, communication with cross functional teams in order to deliver quality code.

KT to new comers on setup, commit, deployments, portal overview.

Senior SW Engineer, 07/2023 to 09/2024

tCognition - India

Company Overview: partnering with ESG Global, UK full time - Remote, India

Titanium is a scalable project for handling electricity and gas bills in the UK

Utilizes an event-driven microservices architecture with Java8, Springboot, Microservices, Restful APIs, JPA, Hibernate, Liquibase, SQL, GIT, Postman, JIRA

Deployed on AWS using Kubernetes

Uses Apache Kafka for data sharing between applications

SKILLS

Good analytical and problem solving skills

Ability to take initiative and be proactive

Framework: Hibernate, Spring Boot,

J2EE Technologies: JDBC, JPA

Languages: C, C++, Java 1.7 and 1.8, groovy scripts

Web Servers: Jboss, tomcat

Databases: Oracle, SQL, MS Access, Liquibase

IDE/GUI: Eclipse(Indigo, Helios, Luna, neon, Oxygen), IntelliJ

Deployment Tool: Jenkins, Docker, kubernate

S/W development Methodology: Agile [certified from Coursera]

Testing tool: Postman

Repositories: GitHub (GitKraken)

Other: Sonar, HP Exstream, SVN, GIT, JIRA, Bugzilla, Putty, WinScp

WEBSITES, PORTFOLIOS, PROFILES

https://www.linkedin.com/in/sunitapa war-188aa684/

Microservice Development: Worked on migration, Billing Authentication, and

Shared Config microservices teams and developed endpoints with Java 8, SpringBoot, microservices, ResfulAPI, Hibernate, JPA, Postman tool

Database Management: Used Liquibase for all database operations

Unit Testing: Conducted tests with Postman Tool, and used Junit, Mockito for test cases

Frontend Integration: Was part of Integration of backend services with the

frontend and resolved issues

Partnering with ESG Global, UK full time - Remote, India



Senior SW Engineer, 08/2021 to 03/2023

Nice Actimize - Pune, India

News Server project detects share market fraud news, receives data from Ravenpack, and delivers news to clients based on specific conditions

Analyzed news using the MSC component, generating alerts for fraud

detection, and contributed to a major release introducing Kafka producers to address news loss

Integrated Kafka on both server and client sides to retain news and incorporated

Kafka into existing functionality

Responsibilities included unit testing, writing test cases, documentation, ensuring sonar code coverage, and sharing knowledge with team members

Utilized Spring Boot microservices, Kafka, SQL, and Hibernate

Consultant, 11/2019 to 08/2021

Capgemini - Airoli, New Mumbai

XDIS (Cross Platform Data Information System) is a Java based application that is used to export the specification

This specification is in a special format that is used by automobile vendors

XDIS is divided into different teams depending on functional chunks like NCDC, Export, Rules batches

The requirements progress is thus traced through the JIRA tasks for design and

implementation phases

Required documents are created, and the corresponding code snippet are placed in the project code repository

Similarly, there is test cases prepared for every CRs in Testlink

The test cases are run against the implementation task during testing phase, to measure the completeness of the requirements

Involved in an analysis of bugs and development of Batches

Part of the sonar team, responsible for maintaining the code smell of the project code

Involved in Quality team and audit team, were working for quality code

delivery, closely working with lead and manager on this part

Additional responsibility to share the knowledge and help other team member

BTA, 02/2015 to 11/2019

Deloitte - Powai, Mumbai

The purpose of this project [State of WY] is to provide state government benefits to the needy people with various programs like TANF, SNAP, Medicaid, etc

The system collects information for an individual, their family members and

households and runs the eligibility which decides the program to be applied to an individual

The system also generates alerts for case workers and interacts with other third-

party federal government applications

It closes case for an individual in cases like change in policy or increase in family income etc

The prime role was the development of complex batches for the application as a

part of its major release in Correspondence team which generates and sends notices to the individual in the form of PDF or emails

We used HP Xstreams tools to design PDF

Involved in the build and deployment team, responsible to build the wars on Jenkins and deploy on the respective servers using Winscp

EDUCATION

BE IT, 06/2014

Pune university

Score: 70



Polytechnic Diploma, 06/2011

MSBTE

Score: 79 SSC, 06/2008

Maharashtra State

Score: 85.84

CERTIFICATIONS

7/2020 - Agile SW Development, Coursera

8/202 - JIRA, Capgemini

8/2022 - Apache Kafka Essential, Nice: Linked In

6/2022 - Basic AIS and ActOne platform, Nice

HOBBIES AND INTERESTS

Reading

Chanting / Yoga

Travelling
